# Custom Home Group

> > Custom Home Group provides expert guidance on custom home building, interior design, and outdoor living spaces.

Custom Home Group (CHG) specializes in custom home construction and design, offering practical advice on everything from interior decor and landscaping to smart home features and outdoor living. Their blog covers design trends, home improvement tips, and planning resources for homeowners building or enhancing custom homes.

## Key Topics

- Custom Home Group (CHG)

- Outdoor living spaces

- [4 Tips for Rock Wall Interior that Works](https://www.customhomegroup.com/blog/rock-wall-interior-tips): 4 tips for incorporating classic rock wall interior design effectively
- [7 Small Bedroom Lighting Ideas](https://www.customhomegroup.com/blog/small-bedroom-lighting-ideas): 7 lighting solutions for small bedrooms including sconces and string lights
- [8 Best Plants for Bathroom Decor](https://www.customhomegroup.com/blog/best-plants-for-bathroom-decor): Guide to 8 humidity-loving plants for bathroom decor including ferns & bamboo
- [6 Pantry Organization Tips to Maximize Your Pantry Space](https://www.customhomegroup.com/blog/pantry-organization-tips): 6 pantry organization tips to maximize kitchen storage and reduce clutter
